author: Dewayne VanHoozer
description: Adds a copilot provider to RubyLLM. Prompts are piped to the GitHub Copilot CLI's stdin and its JSON events are read back from stdout, so the agent (with its own tools, MCP servers and resumable sessions) can be used wherever RubyLLM expects a model, e.g. `--model copilot/default` in aia.

author: Dewayne VanHoozer
description: Adds a codex provider to RubyLLM. Prompts are written to the Codex CLI's stdin in non-interactive mode and its JSON events are read back from stdout, so the agent (with its own tools, config and resumable threads) can be used wherever RubyLLM expects a model, e.g. `--model codex/default` in aia.
